say:2:1610763002:0.text: You look like you've got something on your mind.
say:2:1610763002:0.source_cn: 休，你欲言又止，是遇到了什么很为难的事情吗？

say:3:1610763003:0.text: If you need help, just say the word.
say:3:1610763003:0.source_cn: 如果需要帮忙的话，请告诉我。我将毫不犹豫地履行身为朋友...

say:4:1610763004:1.source_cn: 我……格墨文，我想向你道歉。

say:5:1610763005:1.text: Silven struggles to find the right words, but eventually tells Gervan everything—how their friendship began under false pretenses. When he finishes, he looks relieved, though his trembling hands betray his nerves.
say:5:1610763005:1.source_cn: 休艰难但坚决地将自己和格墨文交朋友时的心态和盘托出。说...

say:6:1610763006:0.text: ... So that's how it was. I see. To be honest, I already knew.
say:6:1610763006:0.source_cn: ……原来真是这样啊。其实，我早就知道了。

say:8:1610763008:1.text: Let's just say I had a feeling. But it doesn't matter.
say:8:1610763008:1.source_cn: 应该说，是我猜到的。但那又怎么样呢？我其实并不介意这一点。

say:10:1610763010:1.text: To be honest, I've dealt with nobles all my life. I'm used to smiles that hide calculations and handshakes that conceal betrayal.
say:10:1610763010:1.source_cn: 恕我直言，我已经很习惯周旋于一个个贵族之间，表面看似热...

say:11:1610763011:1.text: But you, Silven? You may have started with a goal, but you became a true friend. And when you had to choose between ambition and friendship, you chose the latter. You even had the courage to come clean.
say:11:1610763011:1.source_cn: 而你，休，虽然你打算利用我接近王室，但你也是真心想和我...

say:12:1610763012:1.text: I know how to read people. I've watched your actions, and nothing I've seen has ever made me doubt your character.
say:12:1610763012:1.source_cn: 我不会看错人的。我们认识这么久，你的一言一行都能体现出...

say:13:1610763013:1.text: You carry the honor of House Grenvalden. You have your ancestors' kindness, their integrity, their honor. You're a good friend.
say:13:1610763013:1.source_cn: 你是格伦沃顿家族的后裔，你继承了祖先的善良、正直和荣誉...

say:14:1610763014:0.text: So stop blaming yourself. You don't owe me an apology.
say:14:1610763014:0.source_cn: 所以，休，不要为此感到愧疚，也不需要为此道歉。

say:15:1610763015:1.text: As your friend, I want to see you succeed, to see you restore your family's glory.
say:15:1610763015:1.source_cn: 作为朋友，我很希望你能实现你的愿望，重振家族荣光。所以...

say:16:1610763016:1.text: I... I don't even know what to say...
say:16:1610763016:1.source_cn: ……我，我不知道该说些什么，格墨文……

say:17:1610763017:0.text: No need for words. They never quite fit moments like this anyway. Now then, you didn't come all this way just to apologize, did you?
say:17:1610763017:0.source_cn: 言语在这样的时刻总是苍白的。好了，休，你来找我不会就是...

choice_prompt:18:1610763017.text: No need for words. They never quite fit moments like this anyway. Now then, you didn't come all this way just to apologize, did you?
choice_prompt:18:1610763017.source_cn: 言语在这样的时刻总是苍白的。好了，休，你来找我不会就是为了向我道歉吧？

say:19:1610763019:1.text: I see... so you need a high-grade magic gem. Lehman, fetch the Phoenix Star.
say:19:1610763019:1.source_cn: 我明白了。一枚高级的魔法红宝石……雷曼，将“恒火之星”...

say:21:1610763020:1.text: But, young master, that gem was meant for your new staff...
say:21:1610763020:1.source_cn: 可是，格墨文少爷，这枚宝石是您为自己的新魔法杖所准备的……

say:22:1610763021:1.text: It's fine. I have other options.
say:22:1610763021:1.source_cn: 没关系，我还有其他的宝石可以用。

say:23:1610763022:1.source_cn: 遵照您的吩咐，格墨文少爷。

say:25:1610763023:1.text: Lehman leaves briefly, then returns carrying an ornate wooden box. Inside is a ruby that shimmers like a living fire.
say:25:1610763023:1.source_cn: 管家雷曼离开了一会儿。再回来时，他小心翼翼地打开手中的...

say:26:1610763024:1.text: Take it, Silven. The Phoenix Star. There's no ruby more powerful. It should restore your blade perfectly.
say:26:1610763024:1.source_cn: 拿着它，休。这是“恒火之星”，是最好的魔法宝石，不会再...

say:28:1610763026:1.text: Go on, take it. I know what you're trying to say, but as your friend, I don't need repayment or promises. If you really want to do something for me… just thank me, from the heart.
say:28:1610763026:1.source_cn: 拿着吧，休。我知道你想说什么，但作为朋友，我不需要你所...

say:30:1610763028:0.text: A genuine thank-you—now that's rarer among nobles than the Phoenix Star itself. I'll take that as your repayment.
say:30:1610763028:0.source_cn: 真心的感谢——这在贵族之间是比“恒火之星”还稀缺的东西...

say:31:1610763029:0.text: Go on, fix your blade. "Oath of Glory", huh? A fine name... From now on, I suppose I get to share a little of that glory too.
say:31:1610763029:0.source_cn: 快去修复它吧，“荣耀誓约”——真是个好名字啊，从此以后...

say:33:1610763018:0.text: Please, go ahead. I'm curious what brings the two of you here together.
say:33:1610763018:0.source_cn: 请讲，我很好奇到底有什么事能让你们一起来找我。
